### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context"><p>2017 is most recent guidelines, and they are being updated this year (2026). G6PD testing (quantitative) will be included as a recommendation in the new guidelines. There are plans to roll out the STANDARD G6PD test at the district health centre level, after a pilot in the community showed that community testing was not possible. According to the NSP, phased implementation is planned.</p></div>

### Additional policy notes

<div class="country-policy-context"><p>G6PD Testing GF supported, update of guidelines 2023 but have not been able to find them online - according to Dr Mosiqure, 2017 is most recent guidelines, and they are being updated this year (2026). G6PD testing (quantitative) will be included as a recommendation in the new guidelines. There are plans to roll out the STANDARD G6PD test at the district health centre level, after a pilot in the community showed that community testing was not possible. According to the NSP, phased implementation is planned.</p></div>
